pretreatments.description: Freezing pretreatment: Freezing at −20 °C and −80 °C followed by thawing.
Alkaline treatment with NaOH: Soaking in 6% or 10% NaOH solution at 20 °C for 24 h, followed by neutralization with HCl or NaOH solutions to pH 7.5.
Alkaline treatment with NH_3: Soaking in 6% or 10% NH_3 solution at 20 °C for 24 h, followed by neutralization with HCl or NaOH solutions to pH 7.5.
Acid pretreatment with HCl: Soaking in 6% or 10% HCl solution at 20 °C for 24 h, followed by neutralization with HCl or NaOH solutions to pH 7.5.

PEF pretreatment: Applying high voltage (up to 3600 V cm^-1) and rectangular monopolar trains (240 pulses with 50 * 10^-6 s pulse duration) at different intensities (Z_0, Z_0.5, Z_1) and energy inputs.
US pretreatment: Sonication with 50 kHz frequency and power output of 60 W at different durations (40 min and 70 min) to achieve different levels of disintegration (Z_0.5, Z_1).
Combined pretreatment: Freezing at −20 °C followed by alkaline treatment with 10% NaOH.
